title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Kiwi Banana / Straw Banana Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Two Banana-forward blends, two different finishes. Kiwi Banana matches soft Banana with a tangy Kiwi lift, while Straw’ Banana pairs Banana with a sweeter Strawberry note for a smoother, rounder taste. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so both refills can be fitted at once and switched at the device when you want a change. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt support steady MTL vapour, a defined flavour profile and swift nicotine relief. Find your next favourite flavour: Explore all Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Refill Pods How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
